title: Friendliness.SMP
description: You need to calm down? Join this server and it's friendly community.
body:
# **Community**
Some servers have a crazy commnity, and they can be mean sometimes. This server is promised to have a good community and if you do find a toxic or mean player, report the player to an admin.

# **Crossplay**
Crossplay is a work in progress for this server. 6/19/26 (NOT) This server now has Bedrock Support! Same Address and the given port for minecraft bedrock 26.2.

# **Admins**
Our admins will try their best to listen to you.
